classification: Locally frozen evaluation instrument; symbolic controls are not learned-model results.
freeze_scope: Recipe written before generated checks. Local timestamp and SHA256 do not establish independent preregistration or secure execution custody.

world.rule: Unique arbitrary names and values; one value fact per entity; two-hop has one relevant pointer. No conflicting assignments or cycles. Counterfactual changes only the relevant value fact; original query, other facts and fact order stay fixed.
world.splits: Disjoint world IDs, entity/value vocabularies and full-context fact sets. Same grammar templates; no template-out-of-distribution claim.

prompt.preamble:
Use only the facts below. Names are arbitrary.
A fact "X has value V." assigns V to X.
A fact "X points to Y." gives the one outgoing pointer from X.
Return exactly the requested value, or UNKNOWN if it cannot be determined.
Do not add explanations or punctuation.
prompt.two_hop_query: What is the value of the entity reached from {entity}?
prompt.answer_rule: value_[0-9a-f]{12} or UNKNOWN; ASCII space, tab, CR and LF may be stripped only at the outer boundary. Case, punctuation, extra words, Unicode lookalikes and interior whitespace are not normalized.

information_boundary: Only CandidateView(prompt) reaches candidate encode/generate calls. Coordinator IDs, world IDs, split, condition, seeds, original target, oracle answers and oracle facts are excluded. Per-case model state resets; no in-context examples, cross-case memory, tools, retrieval or training. Files are data boundaries, not an OS security sandbox.

conditions_semantics.full_a: Original complete visible fact set; gold follows visible relational semantics.
conditions_semantics.full_b: Same query and fact order as full_a; exactly the relevant value fact changes; answer differs.
conditions_semantics.permuted_a: Same facts and answer as full_a, with a guaranteed different fact order.
conditions_semantics.no_context: Same query with no facts; policy gold UNKNOWN; original-target control uses full_a target separately.
conditions_semantics.broken_chain: Remove the queried value assignment for direct retrieval or relevant pointer for two-hop; policy gold UNKNOWN. Two-hop keeps the destination value visible.

generation.stop_policy: first newline or EOS; max_new_tokens is budget exhaustion
generation.max_budget_output_policy: Budget-exhausted outputs are censored and scored incorrect even if their text matches.
generation.context_policy: Actual model tokenizer input IDs including all BOS/special tokens plus max_new_tokens must fit model context_limit. Otherwise record context_ineligible; never silently truncate. Unknown actual token counts cannot establish eligibility.

primary_endpoint: Within each split and family: fraction of all base worlds with both full_a and full_b strictly correct. No filtering on output availability, formatting, context eligibility or successful acquisition.
secondary_endpoints: All-record policy accuracy by condition with complete denominators.
Original-target contextual gain: mean of 1(full_a output equals A target) minus 1(no_context output equals A target); no_context UNKNOWN policy accuracy is separate.
Permutation joint correctness: both full_a and permuted_a correct; same-answer consistency separately.
UNKNOWN abstention accuracy on no_context and broken_chain.
Missing, context-ineligible, backend-error, budget-exhausted and format-invalid counts.
uncertainty: Descriptive exact numerators/denominators and paired differences only. No confirmatory p-value, efficacy threshold or broad generalization claim; conditions within a base world are dependent.
validation: Reject malformed schemas, unknown or duplicate IDs, incomplete oracle groups, wrong hashes, wrong visible-semantics gold, invalid relations, conflicting facts, changed counterfactual query, overlap across splits and nonfinite JSON. Missing predictions remain explicit incorrect rows.

contamination.meaning: Generated disjoint worlds reduce direct reuse within this instrument. No actual training-corpus overlap or pretraining exposure audit has been performed. Publication itself can expose cases; never claim contamination-free.

artifact_contract.immutability: Generate only into a nonexistent destination directory; exclusive file creation; load verifies manifest and all file hashes. This detects accidental changes, not malicious replacement of all files and hashes.
artifact_contract.predictions: JSONL coordinator records: id, status, raw_text, receipt. Missing IDs permitted and scored missing; unknown/duplicate IDs rejected. run manifest identifies dataset, protocol, decoding, evidence kind and model identity.
artifact_contract.model_receipt: Actual input and output token IDs, input/output counts, prompt SHA256, tokenizer/checkpoint/config/adapter SHA256 identities, context_limit, max_new_tokens, truncated=false, reset_state_per_case=true, stop_reason. Model checkpoint evaluation requires actual tokenizer counts; control receipts cannot become model evidence.
artifact_contract.model_adapter: Python CandidateAdapter contract: identity property, encode_prompt(CandidateView)->list[int], generate(CandidateView)->Completion. Adapter must use exactly the encoded prompt including BOS, frozen greedy decoder and per-case fresh state. Generic runner does preflight and receipts; a real native checkpoint binding is pending.

instrument_controls: Perfect-oracle predictions for scorer self-check only
adversarial_checks: Counterfactual joint endpoint rejects same-answer shortcuts
Actual tokenizer count and receipt validation
not_claimed: Security isolation from an adversarial adapter
Checkpoint execution without a real model/tokenizer receipt
